title: 水質線上感測校正
summary: 以「從校正標準到可追溯水質時序」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow from calibration standards to traceable water-quality series through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 位置與樣品代表性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Location and sample representativeness: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 位置與樣品代表性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Location and sample representativeness and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 感測器讀到的是局部水團；流速、分層和旁流管延遲會改變代表性。
steps.instructionEn: The sensor measures a local parcel; velocity, stratification and bypass delay affect representativeness.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min；計算 2/0.5 = 4 min。適用限制：理想旁流平均時間。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: delay=V/Q; V=2 L; Q=0.5 L/min; calculation 2/0.5 = 4 min. Applicability: Ideal mean bypass residence time.
steps.failure: 停滯旁流管可能讓感測值落後於主流。
steps.failureEn: A stagnant bypass can lag the main stream.
steps.check: 變更旁流量並比較事件到達時間。
steps.checkEn: Vary bypass flow and compare event arrival time.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「水質線上感測校正」的「位置與樣品代表性：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「再生水品質交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Location and sample representativeness: Mechanism and observation” in “Online water-quality sensor calibration”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Water-reuse quality handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 兩點校正斜率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Two-point calibration slope: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 兩點校正斜率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Two-point calibration slope and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 斜率校正把輸出尺度連回已知標準；零點與斜率必須分開估計。
steps.instructionEn: Slope calibration ties output scale to known standards; estimate offset and slope separately.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5；計算 (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input。適用限制：線性區間的兩點估計。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5; calculation (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input. Applicability: Two-point estimate within a linear range.
steps.failure: 用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。
steps.failureEn: Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity.
steps.check: 增加第三個獨立標準檢查線性殘差。
steps.checkEn: Use a third independent standard to check linearity residual.

操作任務：在「兩點校正斜率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.05 output/input，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Use a third independent standard to check linearity residual.
Action: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for two-point calibration slope, first reproduce 1.05 output/input, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5；計算 (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input。適用限制：線性區間的兩點估計。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1); y1=1.1,y2=5.3;x1=1,x2=5; calculation (5.3-1.1)/(5-1) = 1.05 output/input. Applicability: Two-point estimate within a linear range.
steps.failure: 用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。
steps.failureEn: Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity.
